Engineered Arts Ltd is a humanoid robot engineering, design and manufacturing company based in Cornwall, England, founded in October 2004 by Will Jackson. In December 2024 the company restructured as a US company and raised a $10 million Series A led by Helium-3 Ventures ($16.2 million total), and set up in Redwood City, California.

Founder Will Jackson’s positioning has been consistent for twenty years: robots for communication and entertainment, explicitly not labor. The company spent its first two decades selling RoboThespian theater robots before Ameca made it famous.
